validation: Benchmarked 19/10/26: two hand-authored decision cases scored deterministically (scorer 2.3.0) against a baseline without the skill, one trial per arm on a frontier model in isolated no-tool sessions: case 1 3/4 without -> 4/4 with; case 2 3/4 without -> 4/4 with. Results at full marks in both arms are ceiling ties, not proof the skill adds nothing; single trials support no consistency claim.
